- TOTAL revenue reached £38.2k in TW versus £22.1k in LW, a WoW gain of 72.8%.

- TOTAL volume was 18,990 units across 669 orders in TW, with units up 118.2% WoW.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER ranked 1 in TW with £3,740.45, equal to 9.8% of TOTAL revenue.

- JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT posted £2,718.16 in TW (7.1% share), up £1,362.00 WoW, while JUMBO BAG PINK POLKADOT reached £1,917.87, up £1,213.69 or 172.4% WoW.
- JUMBO BAG STRAWBERRY contributed £1,707.48 in TW, and the top five products together held 33.8% of TOTAL revenue.
- CHILLI LIGHTS fell £859.85 WoW, DOLLY GIRL BABY GIFT SET fell £273.09 WoW, and SPACEBOY BABY GIFT SET fell £257.07 WoW.
